******************************************************************
*STATA syntax code for the computation of index*
*values with the German value set (DCE and TTO hybrid)*
*Reference: Ludwig K, Graf von der Schulenburg JM, Greiner W. German Value Set for the EQ-5D-5L. Pharmacoeconomics. 2018 Jun;36(6):663-674.
*Source: https://euroqol.org/information-and-support/resources/value-sets/
******************************************************************;

gen disut_mo = .
replace disut_mo = 0 if missing(disut_mo) & mobility == 1
replace disut_mo = 0.026 if missing(disut_mo) & mobility == 2
replace disut_mo = 0.042 if missing(disut_mo) & mobility == 3
replace disut_mo = 0.139 if missing(disut_mo) & mobility == 4
replace disut_mo = 0.224 if missing(disut_mo) & mobility == 5

gen disut_sc = .
replace disut_sc = 0 if missing(disut_sc) & selfcare == 1
replace disut_sc = 0.050 if missing(disut_sc) & selfcare == 2
replace disut_sc = 0.056 if missing(disut_sc) & selfcare == 3
replace disut_sc = 0.169 if missing(disut_sc) & selfcare == 4
replace disut_sc = 0.260 if missing(disut_sc) & selfcare == 5

gen disut_ua = .
replace disut_ua = 0 if missing(disut_ua) & activity == 1
replace disut_ua = 0.036 if missing(disut_ua) & activity == 2
replace disut_ua = 0.049 if missing(disut_ua) & activity == 3
replace disut_ua = 0.129 if missing(disut_ua) & activity == 4
replace disut_ua = 0.209 if missing(disut_ua) & activity == 5

gen disut_pd = .
replace disut_pd = 0 if missing(disut_pd) & pain == 1
replace disut_pd = 0.057 if missing(disut_pd) & pain == 2
replace disut_pd = 0.109 if missing(disut_pd) & pain == 3
replace disut_pd = 0.404 if missing(disut_pd) & pain == 4
replace disut_pd = 0.612 if missing(disut_pd) & pain == 5

gen disut_ad = .
replace disut_ad = 0 if missing(disut_ad) & anxiety == 1
replace disut_ad = 0.030 if missing(disut_ad) & anxiety == 2
replace disut_ad = 0.082 if missing(disut_ad) & anxiety == 3
replace disut_ad = 0.244 if missing(disut_ad) & anxiety == 4
replace disut_ad = 0.356 if missing(disut_ad) & anxiety == 5

gen disut_total = disut_mo + disut_sc + disut_ua + disut_pd + disut_ad 

gen EQ_index = . 
replace EQ_index = 1 - disut_total
replace EQ_index = round(EQ_index, .001)
